title: M2MCent Universal Actor Input
description: Discover and execute 1,062 live deterministic AI agent microservices natively on Apify. Pass toolName='list' to browse the catalog or specify a microservice slug with its JSON payload.

toolName.title: Tool Name (or 'list')
toolName.description: Name of the microservice to execute (e.g. 'b2b-company-enrich-mcp', 'gas-pulse-mcp', 'serp-markdown-crawler-mcp', 'web3-wallet-kyt-mcp', 'adsb-flight-tracker-mcp', or 'list' to browse the catalog).

payload.title: JSON Payload
payload.description: JSON object with parameters for the selected tool (optional when toolName is 'list', e.g. { "search": "web3", "limit": 20 } or { "domain": "coinbase.com" } for b2b-company-enrich-mcp).
